title: K-flatness under localized open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on its open site, and $U$ an open. Write $A$ for the underlying ring sheaf and $V=\operatorname{overFunctor}(A,U)$ for restriction to the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For every unbounded cochain complex $P$ of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], if $P$ is K-flat over $R$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], then the termwise restricted complex $V(P)$ is K-flat over $R|_U$. The explicit zero-map-preservation witness only defines the map on complexes and imposes no additional mathematical hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 06YB (cohomology-lemma-check-K-flat-stalks), applied to the open subspace; Tag 03DH (sites-modules-section-localize)

proof.text: Identify opens of the subspace U with pairs (W, W ⊆ U). This gives an equivalence with Opens(X)/U: the forward map sends an open of U to its image, which is open in X since U is open, and the inverse takes the subspace intersection. The inclusion morphisms and union-cover conditions agree. The ring sheaf has values R(W) and the module restriction has values P(W). Thus the associated equivalence of module categories identifies termwise overFunctor with ordinary restriction to the open subspace.

For x in U, neighborhoods contained in U are cofinal among neighborhoods in X at x: replace any neighborhood W by W ∩ U. The same transition maps identify the stalk ring and each stalk module of the restriction with the original stalks. These identifications commute with differentials, tensor products and direct sums. By the forward stalk K-flat criterion the stalk complex of P at x is K-flat, so the restricted stalk complex is K-flat as well.

Apply the reverse stalk criterion on the open subspace. Transport along the module-category equivalence from the first step, which identifies all acyclic test complexes and their total tensors, to conclude K-flatness on the localized site. If U is empty there are no stalks and the criterion is vacuous.

    {X : TopCat.{u}} (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) CommRingCat.{u})
    (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
    (hzero : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) U).PreservesZeroMorphisms)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsKFlat (R := R) P) :
    letI := hzero
    IsKFlat (R := R.over U)
      (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} ((sheafCompose
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R) U).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
